safety_invariants: reader-visible drafting consumes authorized evidence only
unsupported, unresolved, disputed or contradicted facts remain blocked
manual or committed editorial divergence fails closed
automatic editorial recovery is limited to exact prepared transaction replay
durable-state recovery requires validated backup semantics
merge, tag and release require explicit human approval
head_binding_policy: The authoritative release head is the exact Git commit on which the final required GitHub Actions workflow succeeds. This manifest is part of that head and does not embed a self-referential commit SHA.
